{
  "name": "@openwork/desktop",
  "private": true,
  "version": "0.0.0-dev",
  "desktopName": "com.differentai.openwork",
  "description": "OpenWork desktop shell",
  "author": {
    "name": "OpenWork",
    "email": "support@openworklabs.com"
  },
  "main": "electron/main.mjs",
  "type": "module",
  "scripts": {
    "dev": "node ./scripts/electron-dev.mjs",
    "dev:electron": "node ./scripts/electron-dev.mjs",
    "build": "node ./scripts/electron-build.mjs",
    "build:electron": "node ./scripts/electron-build.mjs",
    "rebuild:electron-native": "electron-rebuild --force --which-module better-sqlite3",
    "package:electron": "pnpm run build:electron && pnpm exec electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml",
    "package:electron:cloud": "pnpm run build:electron && pnpm exec electron-builder --config electron-builder.cloud.yml",
    "package:electron:enterprise": "pnpm run build:electron && pnpm exec electron-builder --config electron-builder.enterprise.yml",
    "package:electron:dir": "pnpm run build:electron && pnpm exec electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --dir",
    "electron": "pnpm run rebuild:electron-native && pnpm exec electron ./electron/main.mjs",
    "check:electron": "node ./scripts/check-electron-bridge.mjs",
    "typecheck:electron": "pnpm --dir ../server exec tsc -p ../desktop/tsconfig.electron.json --noEmit",
    "prepare:sidecar": "node ./scripts/prepare-sidecar.mjs",
    "pretest": "pnpm --filter @openwork/headless-threads build",
    "test": "node --test scripts/prepare-server-constants.test.mjs electron/after-pack-paths.test.mjs electron/agent-context-diagnostics-fetch.test.mjs electron/automation-runner.test.mjs electron/binary-transfer.test.mjs electron/blank-slate-profile.test.mjs electron/blank-slate-profile-isolation.test.mjs electron/brand-app-name.test.mjs electron/brand-icon-darwin.test.mjs electron/brand-icon-windows.test.mjs electron/browser-login-sync.test.mjs electron/browser-panel.test.mjs electron/context-menu.test.mjs electron/connect-link.test.mjs electron/desktop-distribution.test.mjs electron/dev-profile.test.mjs electron/electron-builder-config.test.mjs electron/linux-desktop-integration.test.mjs electron/no-bare-external-fetch.test.mjs electron/nuke.test.mjs electron/open-external.test.mjs electron/process-resilience.test.mjs electron/runtime.test.mjs electron/runtime-ca.test.mjs electron/runtime-chain-repair.test.mjs electron/sentry.test.mjs electron/server-dependency-mirror.test.mjs electron/secure-vault-key.test.mjs electron/stdio-errors.test.mjs electron/ui-control-server.test.mjs electron/updater.test.mjs electron/remote-workspace.test.mjs electron/workspace-archive.test.mjs electron/workspace-store.test.mjs",
    "test:core": "node --test scripts/prepare-server-constants.test.mjs electron/workspace-store.test.mjs electron/workspace-archive.test.mjs electron/connect-link.test.mjs electron/context-menu.test.mjs electron/open-external.test.mjs electron/secure-vault-key.test.mjs electron/process-resilience.test.mjs electron/stdio-errors.test.mjs electron/runtime-ca.test.mjs electron/runtime-chain-repair.test.mjs electron/automation-runner.test.mjs",
    "pretest:core": "pnpm --filter @openwork/headless-threads build"
  },
  "dependencies": {
    "@modelcontextprotocol/client": "^2.0.0",
    "@modelcontextprotocol/sdk": "^1.29.0",
    "@opencode-ai/sdk": "^1.18.15",
    "@openwork/browser-logins": "workspace:*",
    "@openwork/browser-tabs": "workspace:*",
    "@openwork/enterprise-mcp-client": "workspace:*",
    "@openwork/headless-threads": "workspace:*",
    "@openwork/paths": "workspace:*",
    "@openwork/types": "workspace:*",
    "@sentry/electron": "^7.16.0",
    "ajv": "^8.17.1",
    "ajv-formats": "^3.0.1",
    "better-sqlite3": "^13.0.2",
    "drizzle-orm": "^0.45.2",
    "electron-updater": "^6.3.9",
    "htmlparser2": "8.0.2",
    "jsonc-parser": "^3.2.1",
    "minimatch": "^10.2.5",
    "node-pty": "npm:@lydell/node-pty@1.2.0-beta.12",
    "undici": "6.28.0",
    "yaml": "^2.9.0",
    "zod": "^4.3.6"
  },
  "devDependencies": {
    "@electron/asar": "^3.4.1",
    "@electron/rebuild": "^4.2.0",
    "electron": "^43.2.0",
    "electron-builder": "^26.15.3",
    "electron-devtools-installer": "^4.0.0"
  },
  "packageManager": "pnpm@10.27.0"
}
